description: Buy a multi-level upgrade on an owned (or FSODonated) object, raising its upgrade level and resetting wear. Skill-gated on the server side via `VMNetUpgradeCmd.Verify` which calls `Content.Upgrades.GetUpgradePrice`; the upgrade transaction runs through `GlobalLink.PerformTransaction` against the caller's funds before the command is re-forwarded with `Verified=true`. Effect: object's `UpgradeLevel` advances, behavior/EP tuning may change, `VMEventType.TSOUpgraded` fires.
